content.text: If you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, you know the pain of Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle restrictions. With 149 countries left out in the cold, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-works|How Digital]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-actually|creators]] face a harsh reality: no platform means no sales. The infrastructure problem is clear: rent-based commerce platforms are not built to serve everyone equally. They're designed to cater to the 46 countries where Stripe operates, leaving the rest to find workarounds or go without.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Stripe operates in 46 countries, offering a range of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-8|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processing features and integrations, but it's clear that when it comes to restricted countries, there's no one-size-fits-all solution. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer alternatives, but they're often limited, expensive, or both. Meanwhile, infrastructure players like Cloudflare and Supabase provide the building blocks for custom commerce solutions, empowering digital creators to take control of their sales infrastructure.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Stripe, Gumroad, and Paddle simply don't work. PayPal's account suspension policy can freeze funds for up to 180 days, making it a high-risk option. Lemon Squeezy's own restrictions limit creators in many countries. In contrast, infrastructure-based solutions like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can be deployed in 48 hours, providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that's available worldwide.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed, and fees, Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fee is steep. Gumroad's fees can reach up to 8.5% + $0.30. Meanwhile, infrastructure-based solutions like NOWPayments offer a 0.5% fee, with recommended networks for low fees like BSC, Solana, and TRON. The real cost of using a rent-based platform is the lack of control and flexibility.
Rent-based platforms are not built for everyone, and their limitations can hold creators back from achieving their goals.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

You can sell digital products and collect payments without relying on Stripe or other rent-based platforms. With infrastructure-based solutions like Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can create a sovereign commerce infrastructure that's available worldwide, without the limitations and fees of traditional platforms. By choosing a custom commerce architecture, you can focus on your products and audience, not on navigating platform restrictions.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.
